h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalna

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalna

items.pText: Jalna is a Marathwada town known for its steel re-rolling mills and its seed companies, about 320 km from our factory in Vasai. Schools, housing colonies and factory campuses here ask us for playground equipment, and FunPlay Systems sends every order by road and installs it on site. Rainfall in this part of Maharashtra is low and uncertain, and that affects one step of the job buyers rarely think about.

Grouted equipment sits on concrete foundations, and fresh concrete needs water for several days to cure properly. If it dries too fast in the Marathwada heat, the foundation can crack and the posts may loosen later. Before we install, we check with you that water will be available for curing, even in a dry spell or when the site depends on tankers. On paved or firm ground, self-standing installation avoids the question altogether.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Curing foundations in a dry town

c: Once the posts are set, the concrete around them should be kept damp, usually by sprinkling water or covering it with wet sacking. Do this in the early morning and evening, when the sun is gentler. Keep the play area closed until our crew confirms the foundations are ready, since an early load can crack them. Schedule installation away from the hottest weeks of April and May if you can, and lay rubber flooring only after curing is complete.

items.q: Why does concrete need curing for playground equipment?
items.a: Fresh concrete gains strength slowly and needs moisture to do so. If it dries too fast in hot weather it can crack, and posts set in it may loosen over time.

items.q: Is there an installation method that needs no concrete?
items.a: Self-standing installation, where the equipment rests on its own base, suits firm paved ground or slabs. On open soil we usually grout the posts for stability.

Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Jalna by road, and our installation team or a local dealer installs it according to your approved layout drawing. Send us the site size and photos first, and we will suggest the right method for your ground.
